prompt: Create an accurate image of the Hong Kong Observation Wheel at sunset, with the waterfront skyline visible behind it.

prompt: Create an image of a traditional Cantonese dim sum restaurant table with har gow, siu mai, char siu bao, tea cups, and bamboo steamers.
search_facts: Har gow are translucent shrimp dumplings, siu mai are open-topped yellow dumplings, and char siu bao are white steamed barbecue pork buns.

checklist: Har gow, siu mai, and char siu bao are all represented
Bamboo steamers and tea cups are visible
